card.name: The word patients after a count
card.fires_on: The word patient or patients right after a number or quantity such as 'two or more', 'one', 'no' or 'per'. Also weaker on 'of' or a digit just before a percentage of patients or people.

modes.label: Patients after a count
modes.description: The word patient(s) follows a number or quantity word in trial or adverse reaction text.
modes.example: Neurological disorders of the eye experienced by 2 or more<< patients>> treated with Unituxin in Studies

modes.label: Percent of a group
modes.description: A digit or 'of' sits inside a percentage that is about to name a group of people.
modes.example: electrolyte abnormalities occurring in at least 25%<< of>> patients who received Unituxin/RA

card.writes: It promotes words for groups and counts of people, such as headcount, population and individuals.
card.plain: It fires when a number is being attached to a group of patients, as in 'two or more patients'.
